title: Sprint 2 — CSS Fundamentals & Layout
description: Bring your web pages to life with modern styling and responsive layouts, ensuring they look great on any device.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — CSS Basics & Box Model
tickets.description: Master the basics of visual design. You will learn how to target elements for styling, control spacing, and create a consistent system for colors and typography.

tasks.title: Task 2.1.1 — Selectors & Specificity
tasks.description: Apply specific visual styles to various elements on your page to create a cohesive look.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.1.2 — The Box Model
tasks.description: Design a polished card component by carefully managing its dimensions and inner spacing.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.1.3 — Typography & Colors
tasks.description: Establish a scalable typography and color system to keep your page designs consistent.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Flexbox
tickets.description: Create flexible and dynamic layouts. You will build responsive navigation bars, adaptable grids, and easily align content.

tasks.title: Task 2.2.1 — Flex Navigation Bar
tasks.description: Create a modern, adaptable navigation bar to help users seamlessly browse your site.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.2.2 — Card Grid with Flexbox
tasks.description: Construct a grid of content cards that automatically adjust to fit different screen sizes smoothly.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.2.3 — Centering Challenge
tasks.description: Learn robust techniques to perfectly center various elements across your designs.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — CSS Grid
tickets.description: Take control of complex, two-dimensional page structures and responsive galleries for advanced page organization.

tasks.title: Task 2.3.1 — Grid Basics & Template Areas
tasks.description: Design a comprehensive, full-page layout featuring headers, sidebars, and main content areas.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.3.2 — Responsive Grid Gallery
tasks.description: Create a beautiful image gallery that intelligently reshapes itself based on the viewer's screen.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.3.3 — Grid vs Flexbox Decision Task
tasks.description: Apply the right layout strategies to tackle various everyday design challenges efficiently.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tickets.title: Ticket 4 — Responsive Design
tickets.description: Ensure your applications provide an excellent experience on screens of all sizes, starting from mobile devices.

tasks.title: Task 2.4.1 — Mobile-First Media Queries
tasks.description: Optimize your page layout to gracefully adapt across mobile, tablet, and desktop views.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.4.2 — Responsive Typography
tasks.description: Make your text smoothly scale in size to maintain optimal readability on any device.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)

tasks.title: Task 2.4.3 — Responsive Navigation (Hamburger Menu)
tasks.description: Implement a space-saving, interactive mobile menu to keep your site easily navigable on smaller screens.
tasks.method: In-Browser Combined - DOM Assertion + UI Snapshot Matcher (Method 3)
